category_edits.rationale: Test stronger smoothing across the four most recent observed causal states, increasing their mean contribution from 0.2 to 0.3 for all four category models. Preserve final-real-position selection, backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer; synchronize checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor.

change_summary: Increase recent-four-state pooling to 0.3 and current-state weight to 0.7 across all four NextItNet category models, with matching predictor metadata.
